rationale: Ground truth has no substantive reviewer concerns (two LGTMs plus a bot comment confirming validation passed), so recall is vacuously satisfied by both. Both independently surface the same real gap — two untouched reliability-suite test files (test_invalid_image_generation.py, test_invalid_image_editing.py) that still hardcode the old '3' lower bound and will fail — with concrete file/line/code citations, which is a strong, well-grounded, actionable finding neither ground-truth reviewer caught. Y goes further with two additional plausible, actionable minor findings (missing positive layers=2 coverage, unverified H100 e2e run) and cites more granular evidence (assertion-helper semantics, CI yaml paths, gate status), giving it a slight edge in precision/actionability despite denser prose.
